**Text**

KEYNOTE-189: All-cause AEs occurring in ≥15% of patients in the / as-treated population (original analysis)1,a,b / Median follow-up: 10.5 months / Grade 1-2 / Grade 3-5 / Placebo–plat–pem (n=202) / Pembro–plat–pem (n=405) / Nausea / Anaemia / Fatigue / Constipation / Diarrhoea / ↓ Appetite / Neutropenia / Vomiting / Cough / Dyspnoea / Asthenia / Rash / Pyrexia / Peripheral oedema / Thrombocytopenia / ↑ Lacrimation / Incidence (%) / Adapted from Gandhi L et al. N Engl J Med 2018. / 39 / Data cut-off date: 8 November 2017. / aAEs that occurred during crossover from the placebo-combination group to pembrolizumab monotherapy are excluded. bAEs were graded according to the National Cancer Institute Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events, Version 4.0. / 1. Gandhi L et al. N Engl J Med 2018;378:2078–2092. / 1 / ESMO RECOMMENDATIONS / STUDY OVERVIEW / CLINICAL OUTCOMES / SUMMARY OF OUTCOMES / POOLED ANALYSIS / PD-L1 EXPRESSION / DATA DIVE / DOSING

**Layout**

Full-width white slide with a light grey header band across the top 13% holding the KEYTRUDA logo at left, six grey rectangular navigation buttons in the centre-right, and three circular icons at right. The two-line green bold title sits left-aligned at about 5% margin below the header, with a green subtitle beneath; a two-sided butterfly bar chart fills the middle, with a thin grey rule above the footer, a source line right-aligned above the rule, and the slide number at bottom left and a green numbered circle at bottom right.

**Visuals**

Mirrored horizontal bar chart (stacked bars, Grade 1-2 solid, Grade 3-5 hatched) of all-cause adverse events in the as-treated population, KEYNOTE-189, median follow-up 10.5 months. Left panel: Placebo–plat–pem (n=202), grey bars, horizontal axis reversed from 70.0 at left to 0.0 at right in steps of 10.0, axis unit Incidence (%). Right panel: Pembro–plat–pem (n=405), green bars, horizontal axis 0 to 70 in steps of 10, unit Incidence (%). Category labels sit in the central column between the panels. Legend above each panel: solid square = Grade 1-2, hatched square = Grade 3-5. Values are printed at the bar ends; placebo values listed as Grade 1-2 total at right end and Grade 3-5 at left end: Nausea 3.5 / 48.5; Anaemia 15.3 / 31.2; Fatigue 2.5 / 35.6; Constipation 0.5 / 31.2; Diarrhoea 3.0 / 18.3; Appetite 0.5 / 29.7; Neutropenia 11.9 / 12.4; Vomiting 3.0 / 20.3; Cough 0.0 / 28.2; Dyspnoea 5.4 / 20.3; Asthenia 3.5 / 20.8; Rash 1.5 / 9.9; Pyrexia 0.0 / 14.9; Peripheral oedema 0.0 / 12.9; Thrombocytopenia 6.9 / 7.5; Lacrimation 0.0 / 10.9. Pembro values as Grade 1-2 at left end and Grade 3-5 at right end: Nausea 52.1 / 3.5; Anaemia 29.9 / 16.3; Fatigue 35.0 / 5.7; Constipation 33.8 / 1.0; Diarrhoea 25.7 / 5.2; Appetite 26.6 / 1.5; Neutropenia 11.4 / 15.8; Vomiting 20.5 / 3.7; Cough 21.5 / 0.0; Dyspnoea 17.5 / 3.7; Asthenia 14.3 / 6.2; Rash 18.5 / 1.7; Pyrexia 19.3 / 0.2; Peripheral oedema 19.1 / 0.2; Thrombocytopenia 10.1 / 7.9; Lacrimation 17.0 / 0.0. No estimated values. No highlighted points. Bars are flat, no gridlines, no shadows.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF with a light grey #F2F3F3 header band across the top 13.3% of the slide. White background with a #F2F3F3 header band. Title bold green Arial-like sans-serif #48A548, body and subtitle regular green #48A548, chart labels and axis text grey #585858, placebo bars #808285 with grey value labels, pembro bars #2FA301 with green value labels. **Layout**

Full-width light grey header band holds the KEYTRUDA logo at top left, six grey nav buttons and three green circular icons in a row at top right. Title sits left-aligned at top of the white body area (two lines, with subtitle beneath), followed by a centred two-sided bar chart with legends above each side; source line right-aligned above a thin footer rule, with footnotes left-aligned below and a green numbered circle at bottom right.

**Visuals**

Chart: mirrored horizontal bar chart titled by its series headers, 'Placebo–plat–pem (n=202)' on the left in grey and 'Pembro–plat–pem (n=405)' on the right in green. Categories listed top to bottom in the centre: Hypothyroidism, Pneumonitis (with footnote c), Hyperthyroidism, Infusion reaction, Colitis, Severe skin reaction, Nephritis, Hepatitis, Hypophysitis, Pancreatitis, Adrenal insufficiency, Myositis, Thyroiditis, Type 1 diabetes mellitus. Both axes labelled 'Incidence (%)' with range 0 to 10 and ticks at 0, 5 and 10 on each side, left axis reversed. Legend: solid square = Grade 1-2, hatched square = Grade 3-5. Printed values, placebo Grade 1-2 then Grade 3-5: Hypothyroidism 0.0 / 2.5, Pneumonitis 2.0 / 0.5, Hyperthyroidism 0.0 / 3.0, Infusion reaction 0.0 / 1.0, Colitis 0.0 / 0.0 (no bar), Severe skin reaction 2.0 / 0.5, Nephritis 0.0, Hepatitis 0.0, Hypophysitis 0.0, Pancreatitis 0.0, Adrenal insufficiency 0.5 / 0.0, Myositis 0.0, Thyroiditis 0.0, Type 1 diabetes mellitus 0.0. Pembro Grade 1-2 then Grade 3-5: Hypothyroidism 6.2 / 0.5, Pneumonitis 1.7 / 2.7, Hyperthyroidism 4.0 / 0.0, Infusion reaction 2.3 / 0.2, Colitis 1.5 / 0.7, Severe skin reaction 0.0 / 2.0, Nephritis 0.2 / 1.5, Hepatitis 0.2 / 1.0, Hypophysitis 0.7 / 0.0, Pancreatitis 0.2 / 0.5, Adrenal insufficiency 0.0 / 0.2, Myositis 0.2 / 0.0, Thyroiditis 0.2 / 0.0, Type 1 diabetes mellitus 0.0 / 0.2. No highlighted points. Bars are thin rectangles with solid fill for Grade 1-2 and diagonal hatch for Grade 3-5, sitting on a thin dark grey baseline at each side.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF with a light grey #F2F3F3 header band across the top 13.3%. White body on very light grey header #F2F3F3. Title and subtitle green #48A548, bold sans-serif (Arial-like) for title and regular for subtitle. Body and axis text grey #585858, placebo accents grey #808285, pembro accents green #2FA301. Title about 4.4% of slide height, body text about 2% of height, footnotes about 1.5%. Thin bars with diagonal hatching, no shadows or gradients. Nav buttons are flat light grey rectangles with small square corners and grey text.

### Slide 42

**Text**

KEYNOTE-189: Post-hoc analysis – Evaluation of outcomes in patients with / baseline brain and liver metastases a
Median follow-up: 18.7 months. No statistical conclusions can be drawn from this exploratory analysis
● Extrapulmonary metastases to sites such as the liver and brain frequently occur in metastatic / NSCLC and can be associated with a poor prognosis 1
● Objective of current analysis: retrospectively evaluate outcomes among patients with / baseline liver or brain metastases 2
● Results were not controlled for multiplicity. The cut-off date for this analysis was 21 / September 2018; median follow-up was 18.7 months (range: 0.2–30.9 months) 2
ESMO RECOMMENDATIONS
STUDY OVERVIEW
CLINICAL OUTCOMES
SUMMARY OF OUTCOMES
POOLED ANALYSIS
PD-L1 EXPRESSION
DATA DIVE
DOSING
KEYTRUDA (pembrolizumab)
42
Data cut-off date: 21 September 2018.
a No other data was reported with this analysis.
1. Gibson AJW et al. Med Oncol 2018;35:117; 2. Garassino MC et al. Presented at the 2019 American Association for Cancer Research (AACR) Annual Meeting, 29 March–18 April, 2019, Atlanta, USA.

**Layout**

Full-width light grey header band across the top holds the KEYTRUDA logo at left, six grey rectangular navigation tabs in a row, and three green circular buttons at right. Title and subtitle are left-aligned at about 5% left margin below the band, with three bullets in a left-aligned column below; a thin horizontal rule sits near the bottom with the page number at left and footnotes in a column starting at about 9% left margin.

**Visuals**

No charts, photographs or illustrations. Header contains a logo (KEYTRUDA wordmark in green with a dark navy Y-shaped antibody glyph in the letter Y, with registered mark, and '(pembrolizumab)' beneath in green lowercase). Three circular icon buttons on the right: first is light green (#6BBE45) with a white stylised Y-shaped antibody icon; second is green (#48A548) with white text 'DATA / DIVE'; third is green (#48A548) with white text 'DOSING'. Six rectangular grey tabs (#E3E3E3) with slightly rounded corners carry dark grey uppercase labels.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean white slide with a light grey header band (#F2F3F3). Title in bold green (#48A548) sans-serif (Arial Bold), about 4.4% of slide height, two lines. Subtitle in regular green (#48A548) Arial about 3.3% of slide height. Body bullets in dark grey (#585858) Arial regular about 3.0% of slide height, with green (#48A548) bullet dots; bold lead-in phrase 'Objective of current analysis'. Footnotes in dark grey-slate (#475358) Arial about 1.5% of slide height, bold for the first two lines, italic for journal and author-et-al. Navigation labels in Arial regular about 1.4%. Rule is thin light grey-blue (#B0B8C0). Shapes flat with no shadows or gradients.

### Slide 43

**Review notes**

- Review: The weaknesses are consequential: most data slides use titles that name the analysis rather than state the finding, the Kaplan-Meier, subgroup and AE charts on slides 19 to 28 and 43 to 47 are small with tiny tables and axis text, and footnotes are very small throughout.
- Suggested repair: Enlarge the plots and embedded summary tables on slides 19 to 28 and 43 to 47 so axis labels and statistics are readable at the back of a room.

**Layout**

Full-width white slide under a light grey header band holding the KEYTRUDA logo at top left, six grey nav buttons and three round green icons at top right. The bold green title sits left-aligned at about 16 percent from the top with a green subtitle beneath; below, two equal columns of chart panels (left about 5 to 49 percent, right about 52 to 95 percent) each with a centred bold grey heading, a data table, a Kaplan-Meier plot and an at-risk table. A thin grey rule sits at about 88 percent height with the italic attribution right-aligned above it, and the page number 45 sits bottom left with footnotes in a left-aligned column starting at about 9 percent.

**Visuals**

Two Kaplan-Meier survival line charts (raster images, placed as boxed panels with no border). Left chart titled Patients with liver metastases: y-axis labelled PFS, % ranging 0 to 100 in steps of 10; x-axis labelled Time, months ranging 0 to 33 in steps of 3. Two step curves: Pembro–plat–pem in green (about #3DAE3D) starting at 100, about 74 near 2 months, about 65 near 5 months, labelled 12-month PFS: 27.9% at 12 months, about 17 near 22 months, falling to 0 at about 25 months; Placebo–plat–pem in dark grey (about #6D6E71) falling steeply to about 24 near 4 months, labelled 12-month PFS: 12.9% at 12 months, falling to 0 near 20 months. A dashed grey vertical reference line marks 12 months. Green callout box (about #2E9E3A, white text) and dark grey callout box (about #6D6E71, white text) sit on the curves. Embedded table lists treatment arms with events, median and HR as shown in the text. Below the plot, an at-risk table lists counts at 0 to 33 months in steps of 3. Right chart titled Patients without liver metastases: same axes (PFS, % 0 to 100; Time, months 0 to 33 in steps of 3). Green curve starts at 100, about 40 at 12 months, labelled 12-month PFS: 40.9%, ends near 16 at about 31 months; grey curve falls to about 18 at 12 months, labelled 12-month PFS: 17.9%, ends near 2 at about 25 months. Green callout and grey callout use the same colours. Green tick marks show censored patients. Neither chart uses a legend; series are identified by the table labels. Highlighted points are the two 12-month callouts in each chart.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF with a light grey header band #F2F3F3 across the top 13.3 percent. Clean clinical-deck look on white with a light grey header band #F2F3F3. ### Slide 46

**Review notes**

- Review: The weaknesses are consequential: most data slides use titles that name the analysis rather than state the finding, the Kaplan-Meier, subgroup and AE charts on slides 19 to 28 and 43 to 47 are small with tiny tables and axis text, and footnotes are very small throughout.
- Suggested repair: Enlarge the plots and embedded summary tables on slides 19 to 28 and 43 to 47 so axis labels and statistics are readable at the back of a room.

**Text**

KEYNOTE-189: Post-hoc analysis – OS in patients with brain metastases1,a / Median follow-up: 18.7 months. No statistical conclusions can be drawn from this exploratory analysis / Patients with brain metastases / Patients without brain metastases / Median, months / (95% CI) / Median, months / (95% CI) / Adapted from Garassino MC et al. AACR 2019. / 46 / Data cut-off date: 21 September 2018. / aNo other data was reported with this analysis. / 1. Garassino MC et al. Presented at the 2019 American Association for Cancer Research (AACR) Annual Meeting, 29 March–18 April, 2019, Atlanta, USA. / Navigation: KEYTRUDA (pembrolizumab) / ESMO RECOMMENDATIONS / STUDY OVERVIEW / CLINICAL OUTCOMES / SUMMARY OF OUTCOMES / POOLED ANALYSIS / PD-L1 EXPRESSION / DATA DIVE / DOSING

**Layout**

Single-slide content page with a full-width light grey header band holding the KEYTRUDA logo at top left, a row of six grey rectangular navigation tiles and three circular green icon buttons at top right. The green title sits left-aligned at about 5% from the left margin, with a green subtitle below it; two equal-width chart panels sit side by side in the lower-middle area, each with a centred bold grey heading above it. A thin horizontal rule spans the lower area above the footer, with the page number at bottom left, footnotes in a column beginning at about 9% from the left, and an italic source line right-aligned above the rule.

**Visuals**

Two Kaplan-Meier survival line charts (adapted from Garassino MC et al. AACR 2019), both titled in the slide headings. Left chart: 'Patients with brain metastases'. Y-axis 'OS, %' from 0 to 100 in steps of 10. X-axis 'Time, months' from 0 to 33 in steps of 3. Green series Pembro–plat–pem: about 86% at 4 months, 65.4% at 12 months (green callout label), median 19.2 months (95% CI 15.0–25.9), events 42 (57.5%), HR 0.41 (95% CI 0.24–0.67); it plateaus near 33% after about 27 months. Grey series Placebo–plat–pem: 34.3% at 12 months (grey callout label), median 7.5 months (95% CI 4.6–10.0), events 28 (80.0%); it plateaus near 19% after about 19 months. Dashed vertical reference line at 12 months. Treatment-arm table above the plot with columns Treatment arm, Events n (%), Median months (95% CI), HR (95% CI). No. at risk table below the x-axis: Pembro–plat–pem 73, 66, 61, 52, 47, 45, 38, 25, 14, 5, 0, 0 (at 0,3,6,9,12,15,18,21,24,27,30,33 months); Placebo–plat–pem 35, 27, 21, 15, 12, 10, 8, 5, 3, 1, 0, 0. Right chart: 'Patients without brain metastases'. Same axes. Green series Pembro/plat/pem: about 85% at 6 months, 71.0% at 12 months (green callout), median 22.4 months (95% CI 19.7–25.4), events 171 (50.7%), HR 0.59 (95% CI 0.46–0.75); it ends near 41% at about 31 months. Grey series Placebo/plat/pem: 50.9% at 12 months (grey callout), median 12.1 months (95% CI 9.1–15.0), events 116 (67.8%); it ends near 22% at about 30 months. Dashed vertical reference line at 12 months. No. at risk below: Pembro/plat/pem 337, 311, 285, 264, 236, 211, 196, 119, 65, 23, 2, 0; Placebo/plat/pem 171, 156, 128, 100, 87, 72, 64, 40, 23, 9, 0, 0. Both plots use thin step lines with small tick marks for censored patients. Line colours: green #48A548 and dark grey #585858. Callout labels are filled rounded rectangles: green #2E9E3A with white text, grey #585858 with white text. Header band shows the KEYTRUDA wordmark in green #6BBF45 with a dark navy #1B2A4A stylised Y, and below it '(pembrolizumab)' in grey. The three circular icons are a green antibody-shaped icon on lighter green #6BBF45, and two solid green circles #48A548 labelled DATA DIVE and DOSING.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF background with a light grey #F2F3F3 header band. White slide background with a light grey #F2F3F3 header band across the top 13% of the slide. Title in bold sans-serif (Arial Bold style) green #48A548, about 4.4% of slide height (about 6.2% for capitals). Subtitle in regular Arial, green #48A548, about 3.3% of slide height. Chart headings in bold Arial, dark grey #585858, about 2.7% of slide height. Chart labels and axis text in Arial regular, dark grey #424242 to #585858, about 1.5% of slide height. Navigation labels in Arial regular, grey #585858, about 1.4%. Navigation tiles are flat #E3E3E3 rectangles with small corner radius and no shadow. Footer rule is a 0.5 pt light grey line. Footnotes are in Arial regular and bold, grey #475358, about 1.5% of slide height. Source line is Arial italic grey #585858.

### Slide 47

**Review notes**

- Review: The weaknesses are consequential: most data slides use titles that name the analysis rather than state the finding, the Kaplan-Meier, subgroup and AE charts on slides 19 to 28 and 43 to 47 are small with tiny tables and axis text, and footnotes are very small throughout.
- Suggested repair: Enlarge the plots and embedded summary tables on slides 19 to 28 and 43 to 47 so axis labels and statistics are readable at the back of a room.

**Layout**

Full-width header band across the top with logo at left, six grey pill-style nav buttons and three circular icons at right. Title and subtitle are left-aligned at the same left margin of about 5.1% of slide width, with the title at about 16% from top and the subtitle just below it. Two equal-width chart panels sit side by side in the middle, each with a centred bold heading above it and a left-aligned chart; a thin rule and a right-aligned italic source line sit near the bottom, with the page number at bottom left and footnotes beside it.

**Visuals**

Two Kaplan-Meier survival line charts, both of PFS versus time, drawn as step curves. Left chart titled Patients with brain metastases: y-axis PFS, % from 0 to 100 in steps of 10; x-axis Time, months from 0 to 33 in steps of 3. Green curve is Pembro-plat-pem, grey curve is Placebo-plat-pem. Boxed in-chart table above the curves with columns Treatment arm, Events n (%), Median months (95% CI), HR (95% CI): Pembro-plat-pem 59 (80.8), 6.9 (5.4–11.0), 0.42 (0.27–0.67); Placebo-plat-pem 34 (97.1), 4.7 (2.2–5.5), dash. Callout labels: green box 12-month PFS: 31.7% with dashed vertical guide at 12 months; grey box 12-month PFS: 8.6%. Green curve about 85 at 3 months, about 60 at 6, about 47 at 8, about 32 at 12, about 27 at 15, about 16 at 22 to 24, about 8 from 25 to 28. Grey curve about 63 at 2, about 31 at 6, about 15 at 10, about 8 at 12 to 14, about 5 at 17 where it ends near 3. Right chart titled Patients without brain metastases: same axes. Table: Pembro-plat-pem 245 (72.7), 9.2 (8.3–10.9), 0.48 (0.39–0.59); Placebo-plat-pem 156 (91.2), 4.9 (4.7–5.9), dash. Callout labels: green 12-month PFS: 40.3% with dashed guide at 12 months; grey 12-month PFS: 18.5%. Green curve about 83 at 4, about 58 at 8, about 40 at 12, about 32 at 16, about 28 at 19, about 22 at 23, about 17 at 26, about 13 at 28 to 31. Grey curve about 50 at 5, about 31 at 7, about 23 at 9, about 18 at 12, about 12 at 15, about 7 at 17 to 19, about 1 at 24 to 25. Below each chart a No. at risk table with rows Pembro-plat-pem in green and Placebo-plat-pem in grey, aligned to the time ticks. Left: Pembro 73, 55, 42, 29, 22, 19, 14, 7, 2, 1, 0, 0; Placebo 35, 21, 11, 6, 3, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0. Right: Pembro 337, 273, 224, 168, 127, 100, 77, 47, 26, 9, 1, 0; Placebo 171, 121, 70, 44, 28, 18, 8, 3, 1, 0, 0, 0. Axis tick labels are dark grey and time axis titles are bold. Three circular icons at top right: a light green circle with a white antibody-shaped Y glyph, and two darker green circles reading DATA DIVE and DOSING.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF with a light grey #F2F3F3 header band across the top 13.3%. White background with a light grey #F2F3F3 header band. ### Slide 51

**Text**

KEYNOTE-189: Exploratory endpoint – QLQ-C30 GHS/QoL and functional and symptom subscales 1
Median follow-up: 10.5 months. No statistical conclusions can be drawn from exploratory endpoints
Mean QLQ-C30 GHS/QoL scores:
● Improved from baseline to week 9 in both the pembro–plat–pem and placebo–plat–pem group
● Deteriorated in both groups from week 9 onwards; however, scores in the pembro–plat–pem group remained above baseline whereas those in the placebo–plat–pem group did not
QLQ-C30 functional and symptom subscales:
● Were similar for both treatment groups across all domains at week 12
● Mean score changes from baseline were generally better in the pembro–plat–pem group than in the placebo–plat–pem group for most functional and symptom scales at week 21
● Symptom scale scores for dyspnoea and pain improved in the pembro–plat–pem group and worsened/remained stable in the placebo–plat–pem group
51
Data cut-off date: 8 November 2017.

**Layout**

Single-column layout with a grey header band across the top holding the KEYTRUDA logo at left, a row of six grey rounded-rectangle navigation tabs and three green circular buttons at right. Title sits left-aligned at top of the body area with a green subtitle beneath, then bold grey subheadings with green bullet points in a left column, leaving the right side and lower area empty. A thin grey rule sits above a footer at bottom left with page number 51 at far left, footer text indented to the right, and a green circled number 1 at bottom right.

**Visuals**

Logo: KEYTRUDA wordmark in green #6DBE45 with a dark navy #1F2F5A stylised Y-shaped mark in the letter Y position, with '(pembrolizumab)' below in grey #585858 lowercase. Navigation: six light grey #E3E3E3 rounded-rectangle tabs with grey #585858 uppercase labels on a #F2F3F3 header band. Three circular buttons at top right: first light green #6DBE45 circle with a white stylised Y icon, second green #48A548 circle with white text DATA DIVE, third green #48A548 circle with white text DOSING. Superscript reference and a green outlined circle containing bold green number 1 at bottom right (about 4 percent of slide width, stroke width about 2 pt). Thin grey #B0B5BA horizontal rule across the footer at about 88 percent of slide height. No photographs or charts.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF with light grey #F2F3F3 header band across top. White background with a light grey #F2F3F3 header band across the top 13 percent. Title text bold sans-serif (Arial Bold) in green #48A548, about 4.4 percent of slide height for the title, subtitle regular Arial in green #48A548 about 3.3 percent. Body text regular Arial in grey #585858 about 3.0 percent of slide height; bold subheadings in Arial Bold #585858 at same size. Bullets are green #48A548 solid dots. Navigation tabs flat with no shadow, square-cornered slightly rounded, labels in Arial regular uppercase about 1.4 percent. Footer text about 1.5 percent in Arial, footnote title bold. No gradients or shadows.

**Layout**

Full-width header band across the top with the KEYTRUDA logo at top left, a row of eight navigation buttons on the right and three round icon buttons at the far right. Left-aligned green title and subtitle start at about 5 percent left margin below the band. A centred Kaplan-Meier figure with its statistics table above and number-at-risk table below occupies the middle; the source line is right-aligned above a thin footer rule, with the slide number at bottom left and a circled green 1 at bottom right.

**Visuals**

Chart: Kaplan-Meier time-to-deterioration plot, two step curves, no chart title printed inside the figure. Y axis titled 'Patients without true deterioration, %' (vertical, bold), range 0 to 100 with ticks every 10. X axis titled 'Time, months' (bold), range 0 to 21 with labelled ticks at 0, 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21. Series 1 green (#2FA301) Pembro–plat–pem: starts at 100, about 85 at 1.5 months, about 66 at 4 to 5 months, about 62 at 7 months, about 57 at 12 months, flat at about 56 to 57 through 20 months; the curve ends near 20 months. Series 2 grey (#585858) Placebo–plat–pem: starts at 100, about 80 at 2 months, about 61 at 4 months, about 54 at 6 months, about 49 at 7 to 11 months, drops to about 42 at 12 months, flat at about 42 until it ends near 19 months. Vertical tick marks on each curve mark censored patients; no highlighted points. No legend box; the series are identified by the green and grey labels in the at-risk table. Above the plot is a statistics table with columns Treatment arm a, Events %, Median months (95% CI), HR (95% CI), p value; row 1 green text Pembro–plat–pem | 32.1 | NR (10.2–NR) | 0.81 (0.60–1.09) | 0.161 b; row 2 grey text Placebo–plat–pem | 33.0 | 7.0 (4.8–NR) | – | blank; a thin dark rule sits under the header row. Below the plot is a number-at-risk table, columns at 0, 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21 months: Pembro–plat–pem (green) 402, 189, 128, 72, 32, 11, 3, 0; Placebo–plat–pem (grey) 200, 68, 29, 17, 6, 2, 1, 0. Whole figure is a flat, unboxed, uncropped embedded graphic on white. Circled green number 1 at bottom right is a footnote marker icon.

**Design**

Background white #FFFFFF with a light grey header band #F2F3F3 across the top 13 percent. Title and subtitle green #48A548. Body and footnote text dark grey #585858; nav button labels #585858; statistics table header #424242. Accent green #2FA301 for the superscript footer marker and the Pembro curve. Title Arial Bold, about 4.4 percent of slide height for cap-height text lines; subtitle Arial regular about 3.3 percent; footnotes about 1.5 percent. Nav buttons are flat light grey #E3E3E3 rectangles with square corners and no shadow, labels in Arial regular uppercase about 1.4 percent. Round icon buttons are flat filled circles with no outline. Footer rule is a thin pale grey-blue line #A9B4BC. No gradients or shadows.

### Slide 53

**Text**

KEYNOTE-189: Efficacy summary
ESMO RECOMMENDATIONS
STUDY OVERVIEW
CLINICAL OUTCOMES
SUMMARY OF OUTCOMES
POOLED ANALYSIS
PD-L1 EXPRESSION
DATA DIVE
DOSING
Treatment with pembrolizumab + platinum + pemetrexed in patients with untreated metastatic, non-squamous NSCLC with no EGFR/ALK mutations compared with placebo + platinum + pemetrexed (median follow-up: 10.5 months) yielded:
● Superior OS, with a 51% reduction in the risk of death (HR: 0.49, p<0.001)
● Superior PFS, with a 48% reduction in the risk of progression or death (HR: 0.52, p<0.001)
● Superior ORR (47.6% vs. 18.9%, p<0.001) and improved DOR
● The treatment effect on OS was consistent across all PD-L1 subgroups, including PD-L1 TPS <1% and 1–49%
● The treatment effect was consistent for OS and PFS in a post-hoc analysis of patients with liver or brain metastases (median follow-up: 18.7 months)
In the 5-year follow-up, treatment with pembrolizumab + platinum + pemetrexed continued to demonstrate OS and PFS benefit in patients with previously untreated metastatic non-squamous NSCLC compared with placebo + platinum + pemetrexed (median follow-up: 64.6 months; p not tested):
● Benefits were observed despite an effective crossover rate of 57% from placebo + platinum + pemetrexed to subsequent anti-PD-L1 therapy during/outside study
● Benefits were observed in OS and PFS irrespective of baseline PD-L1 expression
Patients who received 35 cycles of pembrolizumab (~2 years) had durable responses, with 72% patients alive at 3 years (~5 years from randomisation)
53
a Exploratory endpoint – no statistical conclusions can be drawn. b This analysis was post-hoc and exploratory, and no statistical conclusions can be drawn.
1. Gandhi L et al. N Engl J Med 2018;378:2078–2092; 2. Garassino MC et al. Presented at the 2019 American Association for Cancer Research (AACR) Annual Meeting, 29 March–18 April 2019, Atlanta, USA;
3. Garassino MC, et al. J Clin Oncol. 2023;41(11):1992-1998.

### Slide 54

**Text**

KEYNOTE-189: Safety summary
Pembrolizumab + platinum + pemetrexed in patients with untreated metastatic, non-squamous NSCLC with no EGFR/ALK mutations compared with placebo + platinum + pemetrexed displayed a generally manageable safety profile (median follow-up: 10.5 months):1
The addition of pembrolizumab did not appear to increase the frequency of AEs that are commonly associated with chemotherapy regimens involving pemetrexed and a platinum-based drug1
The frequency of deaths due to pneumonitis in the pembrolizumab + platinum + pemetrexed arm was consistent with the frequency previously observed with pembrolizumab monotherapy in advanced NSCLC1–4
No new safety signals were identified in the post-hoc analysis for liver and brain metastases (median follow-up: 18.7 months)a,5
In the 5-year update, toxicity was manageable, which is consistent with previous reports6–8
54
aThis analysis was post-hoc and exploratory, and no statistical conclusions can be drawn.
1. Gandhi L et al. N Engl J Med 2018;378:2078–2092; 2. Reck M et al. N Engl J Med 2016;375:1823–1833; 3. Herbst RS et al. Lancet 2016;387:1540–1550; 4. Garon EB et al. N Engl J Med 2015;372:2018–2028; 5. Garassino MC et al. Presented at the 2019 American Association for Cancer Research (AACR) Annual Meeting, 29 March–18 April 2019, Atlanta, USA; 6. Rodríguez-Abreu D et al. Ann Oncol. 2021;32:881–895; 7. Gadgeel S et al. J Clin Oncol. 2020;38:1505–1517; 8. Garassino MC, et al. J Clin Oncol. 2023;41(11):1992-1998.

### Slide 55

**Text**

KEYNOTE-189: HRQoL summary 1 / This analysis was post-hoc and exploratory, and no statistical conclusions can be drawn / ESMO RECOMMENDATIONS / STUDY OVERVIEW / CLINICAL OUTCOMES / SUMMARY OF OUTCOMES / POOLED ANALYSIS / PD-L1 EXPRESSION / DATA DIVE / DOSING / KEYTRUDA (pembrolizumab) / ● Pembrolizumab + platinum + pemetrexed maintained or improved QoL (evaluated using the EORTC QLQ-C30) compared with placebo + platinum + pemetrexed in patients with previously untreated metastatic, non-squamous NSCLC without sensitising EGFR mutations or ALK translocations / ● At a median follow-up of 10.5 months, median time to true deterioration in the composite endpoint of increased cough, chest pain or dyspnoea was not reached among patients treated with pembrolizumab + platinum + pemetrexed vs. 7.0 months among those who received placebo + platinum + pemetrexed / ● These data complement the superior efficacy observed with pembrolizumab + platinum + pemetrexed over placebo + platinum + pemetrexed in the KEYNOTE-189 study and support the use of pembrolizumab + platinum + pemetrexed as first-line therapy for metastatic, non-squamous NSCLC / 55 / 1. Garassino MC et al. Lancet Oncol. 2020;21:387–397.

**Layout**

Single-column text slide on a white field with a grey header band across the top holding the KEYTRUDA logo at left and a row of navigation tiles at right. The title sits top-left at about 16% of slide height, with the green subtitle directly below it, both left-aligned at x 5.1%. Three bullets run in a left column to about 80% width, with the anchor-and-chain illustration in the lower right; a thin grey rule sits near the bottom, with the page number bottom-left and the footnote beside it.

**Visuals**

One line-art illustration: a black outline drawing of a ship's anchor with its chain coiled on the ground, drawn on white with no fill colour, sitting lower right of the text block and not overlapping the text. Also a KEYTRUDA wordmark logo in green at top left with a stylised Y icon in the K-Y letters, and a row of six grey navigation tiles plus three green circular icons at top right (the first holds a white Y-shaped icon, the second reads DATA DIVE, the third reads DOSING). No charts, tables or photographs.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background with a light grey header band (#F2F3F3) across the top 13% of the slide; navigation tiles are light grey #E3E3E3 with no visible corner radius and no shadow. Title is bold green #48A548 Arial-style sans-serif, about 4.4% of slide height; subtitle is regular green #48A548 at about 3.3%; body text is regular grey #585858 Arial-style sans-serif at about 3.0%, with italic gene names EGFR and ALK. Navigation labels are uppercase grey #585858 at about 1.4%. Accents are green #48A548 bullets and superscript. The footer rule is a thin pale grey-blue line (#B0B8C0) about 0.1% of height. Title, body and footer use generous left margin of about 5% of slide width.

### Slide 58

**Review notes**

- Review: The 89-page route repeats slides (the design, OS and PFS pages recur around slides 58 to 63), which suits a lookup resource more than a sequential presentation.
- What would change the score: Rewrite data slide titles as findings and add a short takeaway line, and cut the duplicated slides 58 to 63 or replace them with links.

KEYNOTE-189: Study design1–3
Multicentre, randomised, active-controlled, double-blind, Phase 3 trial

<30 Gy of RT to the lung in the previous 6 months

58
Footnotes: a Patients were permitted to enrol if their brain lesions were previously treated, clinically stable for ≥2 weeks without evidence of new or enlarging lesions, and steroid-free for ≥3 days prior to receiving study treatment. b Percentage of tumour cells with membrane PD-L1 staining, as assessed using the PD-L1 IHC 22C3 pharmDx assay. c Efficacy assessed in the ITT population. d Assessed by blinded, independent central review per RECIST 1.1. e Assessed in all patients who received ≥1 dose of study medication. f To be eligible for crossover to KEYTRUDA monotherapy, PD had to have been verified by blinded, independent, central radiological review and all safety criteria had to have been met. g Patients who had SD or better after completing 35 cycles of KEYTRUDA or had stopped trial treatment after achieving CR and received ≥8 cycles of treatment, but then experienced PD, could receive second-course KEYTRUDA for 17 cycles if they had received no new anticancer treatment since the last dose of KEYTRUDA.
1. Gandhi L et al. N Engl J Med 2018;378:2078–2092 (and protocol); 2. Gandhi L et al. **Layout**

Full-width header band across the top holds the KEYTRUDA logo at left, six grey navigation buttons in a row and three green circular icons at right. The title and subtitle are left-aligned at about 5% margin below the band. A three-column flowchart occupies the middle: the teal eligibility panel at left, the randomisation box and two arms of boxes in the centre and right, with the two teal boxes (Stratification factors, Endpoints) along the bottom of the chart. A thin teal rule sits near 85% height, with the source line right-aligned below it, footnotes in small type below, and the page number '58' at bottom left.

**Visuals**

Flowchart diagram, no chart axes. Shapes and labels: (1) dark grey rounded rectangle #404040 labelled R / 2:1 / (N=616), with a line leaving its left edge to the teal eligibility panel. (2) Two elbow arrows leave the top and bottom of R: upper arrow labelled n=410 goes to a green box, lower arrow labelled n=206 goes to a grey box. (3) Upper green box #2FA301 reads KEYTRUDA 200 mg + pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 + carboplatin AUC 5 mg/ml/min OR cisplatin 75 mg/m2 Q3W for 4 cycles; arrow to second green box KEYTRUDA 200 mg Q3W (up to 31 cycles) + pemetrexedc 500 mg/m2 Q3W; arrow to third green box KEYTRUDA 200 mg Q3W (17 cycles) labelled Second-course KEYTRUDAg. (4) Lower grey box #808285 reads Placebo (normal saline) + pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 + carboplatin AUC 5 mg/ml/min OR cisplatin 75 mg/m2 Q3W for 4 cycles; arrow to second grey box Placebo (up to 31 cycles) + pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 Q3W; arrow labelled PDf to green box KEYTRUDA 200 mg Q3W (17 cycles) labelled Crossover KEYTRUDA. (5) A grey dashed arrow runs from the right edge of the upper-right green box, down the right side, and back into the right edge of the lower green box, forming a loop. Arrows are thin solid dark grey lines with filled triangular heads. Logo: KEYTRUDA (pembrolizumab) wordmark, green with a dark navy Y. Icons: green circle with a white stylised Y-shaped icon, and two circles labelled DATA DIVE and DOSING.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean white slide with a light grey #F2F3F3 header band. Title is bold green #48A548 sans-serif (Arial Bold) about 4.4% of slide height; subtitle regular green #48A548 Arial about 3.3%. Body text is white Arial regular about 2.2% of height on teal and green panels, with dark grey #475358 headings for the box labels above the boxes. Teal panels #7EA8AD with rounded corners of about 1% of slide width and no shadow. Green boxes #2FA301 and grey boxes #808285 with small corner radii. Navigation buttons #E3E3E3 with text #585858 in Arial regular, uppercase. Thin grey-blue connector lines.

**Layout**

Full-width light grey header band across the top holds the KEYTRUDA logo at the left, a row of six grey rectangular navigation tabs in the centre-right, and three circular icon buttons at the far right. Below it the green bold title sits left-aligned at x 5.1 percent with a green subtitle beneath it, and a centred Kaplan-Meier chart with a treatment table above its plot area and a numbers-at-risk grid below it spans the middle of the slide. A thin rule runs across the lower part at about 88 percent of the height, with the source line right-aligned above it, the slide number at lower left, footnotes in a left-aligned block, and a green ring with the number 1 at lower right.

**Visuals**

One chart, a Kaplan-Meier survival plot, with a treatment-arm table printed above it. Chart type: Kaplan-Meier step plot with censoring tick marks. Title: none printed inside the chart; the slide title serves as its title. Y axis: labelled OS, %, linear, range 0 to 100 with ticks every 10. X axis: labelled Time, months, linear, range 0 to 21 with ticks every 3 (0, 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21). Series 1, green line (Pembro–plat–pem): starts at 100, about 90 at 4 months, about 80 at 8 months, 69.2 at 12 months (printed), about 62 from about 16 months, ends near 20.5 months at about 62. Series 2, grey line (Placebo–plat–pem): starts at 100, about 85 at 3 months, about 72 at 6 months, about 60 at 9 months, about 50 at 12 months (printed 49.4), about 42 from about 14 months, ends near 20 months at about 42. Labelled values printed on the chart: 12-month OS: 69.2% and 12-month OS: 49.4%. Highlighted points: two callout boxes sit on the 12-month position; a dashed vertical grey reference line marks 12 months from the x axis up to the curves. Green callout box fill about #2FA301 with white bold text; grey callout box fill about #6E6E6E with white bold text. Table printed above the plot, columns: Treatment arm, Events,%, Median, months (95% CI), HR (95% CI), p value. Rows: Pembro–plat–pem 31.0, NR (NE–NE), 0.49 (0.38–0.64), <0.001 in green; Placebo–plat–pem 52.4, 11.3 (8.7–15.1), dash, dash in grey. Legend: none as a box; the series are identified by the coloured row labels in the table and the coloured curves. Numbers-at-risk grid below the x axis, rows: Pembro–plat–pem in green 410, 377, 347, 278, 163, 71, 18, 0 and Placebo–plat–pem in grey 206, 183, 149, 104, 59, 25, 8, 0, aligned under the 0 to 21 ticks, with No. at risk as its heading. Other visuals: a horizontal thin grey rule near the bottom; a green ring outline with the numeral 1 at lower right; the KEYTRUDA logo at upper left; navigation tabs and three circular icons at top right, the first circle showing a white stylised Y glyph on light green, the second labelled DATA DIVE and the third labelled DOSING on mid green. Not cropped; the chart is boxed only by white space.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF with a light grey #F2F3F3 header band across the top 13.3 percent of the slide. White slide with a light grey #F2F3F3 header band across the top 13 percent. Title in bold sans-serif (Arial Bold style) green #48A548, about 4.4 percent of slide height for the cap-height-inclusive line size, left aligned. Subtitle in regular Arial style green #48A548 about 3.3 percent. Chart and table text in dark grey #424242 to #585858, Arial style. Footnotes in Arial 1.5 percent, grey #585858 with bold lead lines. Navigation tabs fill #E3E3E3 with no visible border, slight rounded corners, labels in Arial regular #585858 about 1.4 percent, uppercase. Circle icons fill light green and mid green, white text. Slide number 59 in regular grey #585858. Green ring for the 1 in #2FA301 stroke about 0.3 percent of height. Source line in italic Arial #404040. Thin rule in light grey-blue about #B0B8C0. No shadows or gradients.

**Layout**

The page number is at the bottom left and a green outlined circle with the slide number at the bottom right.

**Visuals**

Kaplan-Meier survival chart (line chart, embedded image 1536 by 906 px at x 13.0 y 26.5 w 66.4 h 69.6, not cropped, boxed on white). Title: none printed. Y axis labelled PFS, % ranging 0 to 100 in steps of 10. X axis labelled Time, months ranging 0 to 21 with ticks every 3 months. Series 1: Pembro–plat–pem, solid green line (#2FA301) with censoring tick marks; step-function curve starting at 100 and falling to about 21 at about 19.5 months. Series 2: Placebo–plat–pem, solid dark grey line (#6E6E6E) with censoring ticks; falls to about 9 at about 14 months and then flat to about 19.5 months. Highlighted points: a dashed vertical grey guide line at 12 months crosses both curves; green label box 12-month PFS: 34.1% (white text on #2FA301 fill) sits on the green curve at about 34 percent; grey label box 12-month PFS: 17.3% (white text on #6E6E6E fill) sits on the grey curve at about 17 percent. Legend: none, the series are identified by the statistics table and the at-risk table. Embedded statistics table above the plot: columns Treatment arm, Events %, Median months (95% CI), HR (95% CI), p value; row 1 Pembro–plat–pem (green text) 59.5, 8.8 (7.6–9.2), 0.52 (0.43–0.64), <0.001; row 2 Placebo–plat–pem (grey text) 80.6, 4.9 (4.7–5.5), dash, dash. Embedded at-risk table below the plot: heading No. at risk, column times 0, 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21 months; Pembro–plat–pem (green) 410, 322, 256, 149, 60, 17, 5, 0; Placebo–plat–pem (grey) 206, 141, 80, 40, 16, 3, 1, 0. Logos and icons: KEYTRUDA wordmark logo top left; three round icon buttons top right, the first with a white antibody-style Y glyph on light green, the second and third plain text.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF with a full-width light grey header band #F2F3F3 across the top 13.3 percent. Clean clinical template. Light grey header band #F2F3F3 over a white body. Title and subtitle in green #48A548, bold sans-serif (Arial Bold) for the title at about 4.4 percent of slide height and regular Arial for the subtitle at about 3.3 percent. Chart text and table text in dark grey #424242 to #585858; chart curves green #2FA301 and grey #6E6E6E. Navigation buttons light grey #E3E3E3 with dark grey #585858 uppercase Arial text at about 1.4 percent of slide height, small corner radius. Round icon buttons in greens (#6DBE45, #3E9E3A, #4CA845) with white text. Footnotes in grey #585858 at about 1.5 percent of slide height, bold for the first lines and regular for the reference line. **Layout**

Full-width white slide with a light grey header band across the top holding the KEYTRUDA logo at left, a row of navigation buttons across the centre and right, and three round icon buttons at far right. The title sits left-aligned at about 5% from the left edge below the header, followed by a green subtitle, then a full-width table occupying the middle, a right-aligned citation above a thin rule, and a footnote block with slide number 61 at bottom left and a green circled number 1 at bottom right.

**Visuals**

Table, untitled, 3 columns by 11 body rows plus a two-line header row. Columns: row label column (AE, n (%)); Pembro–plat–pem (n=405) with green header fill; Placebo–plat–pem (n=202) with grey header fill. Rows and values: All causes 404 (99.8) / 200 (99.0); Grade 3–5b 272 (67.2) / 133 (65.8); Led to death 27 (6.7) / 12 (5.9); Led to discontinuation (no values); All treatmentc 56 (13.8) / 16 (7.9); Any treatment component 112 (27.7) / 30 (14.9); Immune-mediatedd 92 (22.7) / 24 (11.9); Grade 3–5b 36 (8.9) / 9 (4.5); Led to death 3 (0.7)e / 0. No chart, no photographs, no highlighted points. Logo: KEYTRUDA wordmark in green with a dark navy Y-shaped antibody glyph in the centre of the word, with (pembrolizumab) beneath. Icons: three round header buttons, the first light green (#6CBE45) with a white antibody glyph, the second mid green (#4BA83A) reading DATA DIVE, the third mid green (#4BA83A) reading DOSING. Green circled numeral 1 at bottom right, outlined in #2FA301 with a thick stroke.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean clinical look on white. Header band light grey #F2F3F3. Title in bold green #48A548, about 4.4% of slide height (roughly 3.3% cap height equivalent, large sans); subtitle in regular green #48A548 at about 3.3%. Table header cells: green #2FA301 for Pembro column and grey #808285 for Placebo column, white text about 2.6%. Row label text dark grey #3F3F3F, body about 2.6% of slide height, regular weight; the AE, n (%) header in bold dark slate #37424A. Row bands alternate #F2F2F2 and #FFFFFF with thin green #2FA301 rules between rows. Navigation buttons are light grey rounded rectangles with grey #585858 uppercase labels at about 1.4%. Typeface is Arial (Helvetica-like) sans-serif throughout. Footnotes in bold dark grey #475358 at about 1.5%, superscripts about 1.0%. Citation in italic #404040 at about 1.7%.

**Layout**

Full-width header band across the top with the KEYTRUDA logo at left, a row of six grey nav buttons and three green circular icons at right. Title block is left-aligned at about 5% margin below the band, with a two-line green bold title, a subtitle line and then a centred-around-middle back-to-back bar chart occupying the lower two-thirds (labels in the left and right halves, value axes along the bottom). Source line is right-aligned above a thin rule; footer with page number 63 at left, footnotes from about 9% to 4% margin, and a green circled page number at bottom right.

**Visuals**

Chart: back-to-back horizontal stacked bar chart, Incidence (%) of immune-mediated adverse events. Left panel titled Placebo–plat–pem (n=202) in grey, bars extend leftward from a zero axis at the centre, x-axis 10 to 0 (ticks 10, 5, 0). Right panel titled Pembro–plat–pem (n=405) in green, bars extend rightward, x-axis 0 to 10 (ticks 0, 5, 10). Axis label Incidence (%) centred beneath. Legend above each panel: solid square = Grade 1-2, hatched square = Grade 3-5. Grey bars are solid #808285 for Grade 1-2 and diagonally hatched grey for Grade 3-5; green bars are solid #2FA301 for Grade 1-2 and green-hatched for Grade 3-5. Labelled values (placebo grade 1-2 / grade 3-5 at bar ends, pembro grade 1-2 at left end and grade 3-5 at right end): Hypothyroidism placebo 0.0 / 2.5, pembro 6.2 / 0.5; Pneumonitis placebo 2.0 / 0.5, pembro 1.7 / 2.7; Hyperthyroidism placebo 0.0 / 3.0, pembro 4.0 / 0.0; Infusion reaction placebo 0.0 / 1.0, pembro 2.3 / 0.2; Colitis placebo 0.0 / 0.0, pembro 1.5 / 0.7; Severe skin reaction placebo 2.0 / 0.5, pembro 0.0 / 2.0; Nephritis placebo 0.0 / 0.0, pembro 0.2 / 1.5; Hepatitis placebo 0.0 / 0.0, pembro 0.2 / 1.0; Hypophysitis placebo 0.0 / 0.0, pembro 0.7 / 0.0; Pancreatitis placebo 0.0 / 0.0, pembro 0.2 / 0.5; Adrenal insufficiency placebo 0.5 / 0.0, pembro 0.0 / 0.2; Myositis placebo 0.0 / 0.0, pembro 0.2 / 0.0; Thyroiditis placebo 0.0 / 0.0, pembro 0.2 / 0.0; Type 1 diabetes mellitus placebo 0.0 / 0.0, pembro 0.0 / 0.2. Pneumonitis carries superscript c. No highlighted points. Logos/icons: KEYTRUDA wordmark with registered mark, green Y-shaped pembrolizumab icon in a light green circle, data dive circle and dosing circle. Page-number badge: green outlined circle with bold green 1.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF, with the top header band in light grey #F2F3F3. Clean white and light grey corporate look. Header band light grey #F2F3F3. Title bold green #48A548 in Arial-style sans-serif, title cap height about 4.4% of slide height; subtitle regular green #48A548 about 3.3%. Body and axis text grey #585858, about 1.7–2.0%. Footnote text bold grey #475358 about 1.5%. Nav buttons light grey #E3E3E3 with no visible border, square corners, grey #585858 caps text about 1.4%. Circular icons in green (#5DB946 range for Y icon, #2FA301 for data dive and dosing circles) with white caps text. Bars have no outlines; hatched grade 3-5 pattern is diagonal stripes. Thin grey axis lines #585858 at bottom of each panel. Thin grey horizontal rule #C0C4C8 above footer.

**Layout**

Full-bleed green slide with a white header band across the top holding the KEYTRUDA logo at left and a row of six grey navigation buttons plus three green circular buttons at right. The title block is left-aligned at x 11.4% and sits in the vertical middle-left of the green field, with the white line illustration filling the right third and the footnote at the bottom left at y 92.3%. There is no page number or footer band.

**Visuals**

Full-width white line-art illustration at right of a small sailboat on rippling water with four seagulls above it. The sailboat is a single-masted yacht seen from the side with one sailor at the stern, drawn in white outline on the green background with no fill. The birds are white outline gulls in flight. The water lines run across the lower right at about y 82% to 91%. Also present: the KEYTRUDA (pembrolizumab) logo at top left in green and grey, three green circle buttons labelled with a Y symbol, DATA DIVE and DOSING.

Background: Solid green #48A548 across the whole slide, with a white header band at top. ### Slide 65

**Text**

KEYNOTE-407: Study design1–3 / Randomised, double-blind, Phase 3 trial / KEYTRUDA® (pembrolizumab) / ESMO RECOMMENDATIONS / STUDY OVERVIEW / CLINICAL OUTCOMES / SUMMARY OF OUTCOMES / POOLED ANALYSIS / PD-L1 EXPRESSION / DATA DIVE / DOSING / Key eligibility criteria / • Untreated stage IV NSCLC with squamous histology / • ECOG PS 0 or 1 / • Provision of a sample for PD-L1 assessment / • No symptomatic CNS metastases / • No history of non-infectious pneumonitis requiring use of glucocorticoids, no active autoimmune disease and no systemic immunosuppressive treatment / R / 1:1 / (N=559) / n=278 / Pembrolizumab 200 mg Q3W + carboplatin AUC 6 mg/ml/min Q3W + paclitaxel 200 mg/m2 Q3W OR nab-paclitaxel 100 mg/m2 Q1W for 4 cycles Q3W / Pembrolizumab 200 mg Q3W (up to 31 cycles) / n=281 / Placebo (normal saline) Q3W + carboplatin AUC 6 mg/ml/min Q3W + paclitaxel 200 mg/m2 Q3W OR nab-paclitaxel 100 mg/m2 Q1W for 4 cycles Q3W / Placebo (normal saline) Q3W (up to 31 cycles) / PDc / Optional crossover:c / Pembrolizumab 200 mg Q3W (up to 35 cycles) / Stratification factors / • PD-L1 expression (TPSa <1% vs. ≥1%) / • Choice of taxane (paclitaxel vs. nab-paclitaxel) / • Geographic region (East Asia vs. rest of World) / Endpoints / • Primary: OS, PFSb / • Secondary: ORR,b DOR,b safety / • Exploratory: Effect of PD-L1 expression on efficacy, PROs / Adapted from Paz-Ares L et al. N Engl J Med 2018; Paz-Ares L et al. ASCO 2018; Robinson AG et al. ELCC 2021. / 65 / aPercentage of tumour cells with membrane PD-L1 staining, as assessed using the PD-L1 IHC 22C3 pharmDx assay. bAssessed by blinded, independent central review per RECIST v1.1. cPatients in the placebo arm could cross over to pembrolizumab 200mg Q3W during the induction or maintenance phase. To be eligible for crossover, PD must have been verified by blinded, independent, central radiological review and all safety criteria had to have been met. / 1. Paz-Ares L et al. N Engl J Med 2018; 379:2040–2051 (and protocol); 2. Paz-Ares L et al. Presented at American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) Annual Meeting 2018, 1–5 June, 2018, Chicago, USA; / 3. Robinson AG et al. Presented at the European Lung Cancer Virtual Congress (ELCC) 2021, 25–27 March 2021.

**Layout**

Full-width header band across the top with the KEYTRUDA logo at left, a row of eight navigation tabs and three circular buttons at right. The title and subtitle are left-aligned at the left margin (about 5% from the left) beneath the header. A two-column flow diagram fills the middle: an eligibility box and stratification/endpoint boxes on the left, a randomisation box with two arms in the centre, and outcome boxes on the right, with a crossover box at lower right. A source line is right-aligned above a thin rule, and footnotes and the page number sit below the rule at the bottom left.

**Visuals**

Flow diagram. Shapes: a large rounded teal box titled Key eligibility criteria with five bullets; a dark grey rounded box labelled R / 1:1 / (N=559) at centre; a green rounded box for the pembrolizumab arm (n=278) and a grey rounded box for the placebo arm (n=281); a green box Pembrolizumab 200 mg Q3W (up to 31 cycles) and a grey box Placebo (normal saline) Q3W (up to 31 cycles) to the right of each arm; a green box Optional crossover: Pembrolizumab 200 mg Q3W (up to 35 cycles) at lower right; teal boxes Stratification factors (lower left) and Endpoints (lower centre). Connectors: a horizontal grey line from the eligibility box to the R box; an elbow connector from R up to the pembrolizumab arm and down to the placebo arm, each with a filled arrowhead; a short horizontal arrow from each arm to its outcome box; a vertical arrow down from the placebo outcome box to the crossover box, labelled PDc. No chart or table.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF, with a light grey header band #F2F3F3 across the top 13% of the slide.

**Layout**

Full-width light grey header band across the top 13% of the slide holds the KEYTRUDA logo at left, six grey rectangular navigation buttons in the centre-right and three green circular icons at the far right. The title sits left-aligned at about 5% margin under the header at about 16% from the top, with the subtitle beneath it; the chart block with its results table and at-risk table is centred in the middle-lower area. Footer rule sits near 88% with page number 66 at left margin and a green circled 1 at bottom right. The slide carries no legal text.

**Visuals**

One Kaplan–Meier survival chart with an embedded results table above it and a numbers-at-risk table below it. Chart: title none printed; x-axis labelled 'Time, months' running 0 to 21 with ticks every 3 months (0, 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21); y-axis labelled 'OS, %' running 0 to 100 with ticks every 10. Series 1, green line (Pembrolizumab + carb-pac/nabpac): labelled 12-month OS 65.2%; curve about 100% at time 0, about 85% near 4 months, about 74% near 9 months, about 65% at 12 months, about 52% near 15 months, ending about 40% near 18 months. Series 2, grey line (Placebo + carb-pac/nabpac): labelled 12-month OS 48.3%; curve about 100% at time 0, about 80% near 5 months, about 63% near 8 months, about 48% at 12 months, about 38% near 15 months, ending about 33% near 18.5 months. Both series show small vertical censoring tick marks. Highlighted point: dashed vertical grey reference line at 12 months connecting both labelled call-outs. Legend: none separate; series identified by green and grey text in the table and at-risk rows. Results table columns: Treatment arm; Events, %; Median, months (95% CI); HR (95% CI); p value. Rows: Pembrolizumab + carb-pac/nabpac (green text) 30.6 | 15.9 (13.2–NE) | 0.64 (0.49–0.85) | <0.001; Placebo + carb-pac/nabpac (grey text) 42.7 | 11.3 (9.5–14.8) | — | —. At-risk table: header No. at risk; row Pembrolizumab + carb-pac/nabpac (green) 278, 256, 188, 124, 62, 17, 2, 0 at times 0 to 21 by 3 months; row Placebo + carb-pac/nabpac (grey) 281, 246, 175, 93, 45, 16, 4, 0. Logos and icons: KEYTRUDA wordmark logo top left; green circular icon with white Y-shaped glyph; green circular icon labelled DATA DIVE; green circular icon labelled DOSING.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean white content area with a pale grey #F2F3F3 header band. Title and subtitle in green #48A548; body and table text in dark grey #585858 and #424242; green accent #2FA301 for the page-number circle and green series; grey series #7F7F7F. **Layout**

Header band across the top with the KEYTRUDA logo at left, six grey navigation buttons and three green circular buttons at right. Title and subtitle are left-aligned at a margin of about 5% from the left edge; a mirrored two-panel bar chart fills the middle, with category labels in a centre column, and a footer rule sits near 89% of height with the page number 69 at left and a green circled 1 at bottom right.

**Visuals**

Mirrored horizontal bar chart of all-cause adverse events in ≥15% of patients, as-treated population, KEYNOTE-407 (original analysis). Left panel: Placebo + carb-pac/nabpac (n=280), bars in slate teal #7FAAB0 pointing left, value axis 0 to 60 % incidence, ticks every 10 at bottom with 60 at left and 0 at right. Right panel: KEYTRUDA + carb-pac/nabpac (n=278), bars in green #6CC04A pointing right, value axis 0 to 60 % incidence with ticks every 10. Grade 1-2 shown as solid bars; Grade 3-5 shown as diagonally hatched segments at the end of each bar. Printed values, placebo (Grade 3-5 hatched value, total) then KEYTRUDA (Grade 1-2 solid value, Grade 3-5 hatched value): Anaemia 20.4 / 31.4 and 37.7 / 15.5; Alopecia 1.1 / 35.3 and 45.6 / 0.4; Neutropenia 24.6 / 8.3 and 15.1 / 22.7; Nausea 1.4 / 30.7 and 34.5 / 1.1; Thrombocytopenia 6.4 / 16.8 and 23.8 / 6.8; Diarrhoea 2.1 / 21.1 and 25.9 / 4.0; Appetite 1.8 / 27.5 and 22.3 / 2.2; Constipation 1.1 / 20.7 and 22.3 / 0.7; Fatigue 3.9 / 21.8 and 19.5 / 3.2; Asthenia 3.6 / 17.5 and 19.4 / 2.2; Arthralgia 0.7 / 13.6 and 19.1 / 1.4; Peripheral neuropathy 0.7 / 15.4 and 19.4 / 1.1; Vomiting 2.1 / 9.7 and 15.8 / 0.4; Cough 1.1 / 15.7 and 12.6 / 0.7; Dyspnoea 1.1 / 15.0 and 11.5 / 1.4. Legend at lower left of left panel and lower right of right panel: square key for Grade 1-2 and hatched key for Grade 3-5. No highlighted points. Source line in italic at lower right of chart. Logos: KEYTRUDA (pembrolizumab) wordmark at top left; three circular green icons at top right (a stylised Y-shaped ligand/receptor glyph in light green, Data Dive text, Dosing text).

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF with a light grey #F2F3F3 header band across the top 13.3% of the slide. Clean white slide with a light grey #F2F3F3 header band. Titles are bold green #48A548 sans-serif (Arial Bold) at about 4.4% of slide height per line; subtitle and axis labels are regular Arial in green #48A548 and grey #585858; body and footnote text is Arial 1.5% of slide height in grey #585858; source line is Arial Italic in #404040. Navigation buttons are flat light grey #E3E3E3 rectangles with slightly rounded corners, uppercase Arial 1.4% of height in #585858. Circular buttons are solid greens (#6CC04A, #48A548 and #2FA301 tones). Footer rule is a thin grey-blue line. Chart bars have no outlines and no shadows; the centre column is white #FFFFFF.

**Layout**

Full-width header band across the top holding the KEYTRUDA logo at left, six grey rectangular navigation buttons in a row, and three green circular icon buttons at right. A right-aligned source line sits above a thin horizontal footer rule, with the page number at lower left and footnotes in a three-line block to its right; no slide-number is placed in a corner other than the footer number 70.

**Visuals**

Back-to-back horizontal bar chart (KEYNOTE-407 immune-mediated adverse events, as-treated population, original analysis, median follow-up 7.8 months). Left panel: Placebo + carb-pac/nabpac (n=280), teal bars, grade 1-2 solid and grade 3-5 diagonally hatched; bars extend leftward on a reversed axis labelled 10, 5, 0 (percent, Incidence, %). Right panel: Pembrolizumab + carb-pac/nabpac (n=278), green bars, grade 1-2 solid and grade 3-5 diagonally hatched; bars extend rightward on an axis labelled 0, 5, 10 (Incidence, %). Central column lists categories: Hypothyroidism, Hyperthyroidism, Pneumonitis (footnote c), Infusion reactions, Colitis, Hepatitis, Severe skin reactions, Hypophysitis, Thyroiditis, Nephritis. Labelled values, placebo grade 1-2 then grade 3-5 from left panel: Hypothyroidism 0.0 / 1.8; Hyperthyroidism 0.0 / 0.7; Pneumonitis 1.1 / 1.0; Infusion reactions 0.4 / 1.7; Colitis 1.1 / 0.3; Hepatitis 0.0; Severe skin reactions 0.4 / 0.0; Hypophysitis 0.0; Thyroiditis 0.0; Nephritis 0.7 / 0.0. Pembrolizumab grade 1-2 then grade 3-5: Hypothyroidism 7.5 / 0.4; Hyperthyroidism 6.8 / 0.4; Pneumonitis 4.0 / 2.5; Infusion reactions 1.5 / 1.4; Colitis 0.3 / 2.2; Hepatitis 0.0 / 1.8; Severe skin reactions 0.7 / 1.1; Hypophysitis 0.4 / 0.7; Thyroiditis 0.7 / 0.4; Nephritis 0.0 / 0.7. No estimates needed as all values are printed. No highlighted points. Legend at upper left of left panel (Grade 1-2 solid teal square, Grade 3-5 hatched teal square) and upper right of right panel (Grade 1-2 solid green square, Grade 3-5 hatched green square). Chart elements are a raster image; the bar area is clipped to the image boxes with no border. Small raster image at lower right of the chart area, about 328 by 65 pixels, not distinctly legible. Logo: KEYTRUDA (pembrolizumab) wordmark at top left, with a stylised Y glyph in the letter Y. Icons: white stylised Y glyph inside the first green circle, plus text-labelled green circles DATA DIVE and DOSING.

### Slide 71

**Text**

KEYTRUDA® (pembrolizumab) / ESMO RECOMMENDATIONS / STUDY OVERVIEW / CLINICAL OUTCOMES / SUMMARY OF OUTCOMES / POOLED ANALYSIS / PD-L1 EXPRESSION / DATA DIVE / DOSING / Post-hoc exploratory pooled / analysis (KEYNOTE-189, / KEYNOTE-407) / 5-year survival with KEYTRUDA® / (pembrolizumab) plus chemotherapy for / mNSCLC with PD-L1 TPS <1%1 / 1. Gadgeel S et al. 5-year survival of pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy for metastatic NSCLC with PD-L1 tumor proportion score <1%. / Presented at the WCLC, 9-12 September 2023, Singapore. 2023

**Layout**

A white header band across the top (about the top 13% of the slide) holds the KEYTRUDA (pembrolizumab) logo at the left margin, a row of six grey rounded navigation buttons in the centre-right, and three green circular buttons at the right edge. Below the header, the title block is left-aligned at about 11% from the left edge, with the bold title starting at about 32% height and the subtitle beneath it; the illustration fills the right third and the footnote sits at the bottom left, about 90% down the slide. No slide number is visible.

**Visuals**

Right-side line illustration in white strokes on the navy background: a single-masted sailing boat with a mainsail and jib, a small figure at the stern, a hull with portholes, wavy water lines beneath it, and four seabirds in flight above the mast (two at upper right, one at upper centre-left, one at centre right). Drawn as thin white outlines with no fill, placed directly on the background, not boxed, not cropped. Header logos: a green KEYTRUDA wordmark with a dark-navy Y-shaped mark in the letter position of Y and a registered mark, with '(pembrolizumab)' in grey below it; and three green circular icons, the first containing a white stylised Y-shape (light green #6CC04A), the second labelled DATA DIVE and the third labelled DOSING (green #4CAF50).

**Design**

Background: Solid navy #2A3166 full-bleed background. Full-bleed navy background #2A3166 across the whole slide; header band white #FFFFFF with a thin edge. Navigation buttons are light grey #E3E3E3 rounded rectangles with small corner radius and grey #585858 uppercase sans-serif text (ArialMT, about 1.4% of slide height). Title is bold white #FFFFFF Arial-BoldMT, about 6.5% of slide height (cap height about 4.6%), tight leading. Subtitle is regular white #FFFFFF ArialMT about 4.4% of slide height, sentence case, line spacing about 5.3% of slide height. Footnote is white ArialMT about 1.5% of slide height. Logo wordmark KEYTRUDA in green #6CC04A with navy accent. No shadows, gradients or decorative lines other than the illustration.

J Thor Oncol 2024. / 72 / The exploratory pooled analysis included patient data from KEYNOTE-189 global (data cut-off March 8, 2022) and Japan extension (data cut-off February 7, 2023) and the KEYNOTE-407 global (data cut-off February 23, 2022) and China extension (data cut-off February 10, 2023). / a All 442 patients had PD-L1 TPS <1% [negative]. b PD-L1 expression was centrally assessed using PD-L1 IHC 22C3 pharmDX (Agilent Technologies, Carpinteria, CA). c Tumour response was assessed per RECIST-v1.1 by blinded independent central review (BICR). d Efficacy was evaluated in the intention-to-treat population and safety in the as-treated population. e Included 40 patients from the Japan extension. f Included 125 patients from the China extension. 6 / 1. **Layout**

Single-slide flow diagram on a white field under a light grey header band; the title sits top-left below the header, left-aligned at about 5% from the left edge. Four column headings run across the top of the diagram, separated by thin vertical grey rules; the flow runs left to right in two rows (KEYNOTE-189 upper, KEYNOTE-407 lower). A grey source line is right-aligned above a thin horizontal rule near the bottom; the page number 72 sits bottom-left and the footnotes fill the bottom band to the right of it.

**Visuals**

Flow diagram, no photographs. Left column: two navy (#2A3166) right-pointing chevron arrow shapes, one per trial (KEYNOTE-189 upper, KEYNOTE-407 lower). Second column: two navy chevron shapes labelled with extension and N values. Third column: four small rectangles, two green (#2FA301) labelled n=140 and n=115 and two grey (#808285) labelled n=66 and n=121, each pair stacked by row. Dotted connector lines (dark grey) run from the third-column boxes to a vertical dotted bus at about x 49%, which feeds four wide rectangles stacked in a column: green PD-L1 TPS <1% NSq + ‘other’ (n=144), green PD-L1 TPS <1% Sq (n=111), grey PD-L1 TPS <1% NSq + ‘other’ (n=68), grey PD-L1 TPS <1% Sq (n=119). A second dotted bus at about x 74% connects these to the far-right boxes: green KEYTRUDA + chemo (n=255) at top, grey Placebo + chemo (n=187) below, and a dotted arrow from Placebo + chemo to a green box Crossover to KEYTRUDA on study (n=76) at far right. Small dark green dots mark the junction points of the connectors. No charts or photographs.

**Design**

Background white with a very light grey header band (#F2F3F3) across the top 13% of the slide containing the navigation. Titles and key headings in KEYTRUDA green #48A548; body text in dark grey #585858; the KEYNOTE-189 and KEYNOTE-407 labels in light green #6FBF4A; accents green #2FA301 and navy #2A3166; neutral grey boxes #808285. Typefaces appear to be Arial (sans-serif): Arial Bold for the title and headings, Arial regular for box text, Arial Italic for citations and the trial abbreviations. Title is about 4.4% of slide height, column headings about 2.0%, box text about 2.2%, footnotes about 1.5%. Rectangles are square-cornered with no shadows; chevron arrows are flat navy with sharp points; connectors are thin dotted lines. Source line and page number in grey.

**Layout**

Full-width header band across the top with the KEYTRUDA logo at left, six grey rectangular navigation tabs and three green circular icons at right. Title and subtitle are left-aligned at about 5% left margin below the band, with the chart image occupying the left-centre and the results table at upper right of the chart area. Footer has the page number at left, a rule above the footnotes, and the source line right-aligned above the footnotes.

**Visuals**

Chart (Kaplan-Meier curves, placed raster image, about 75% of slide width, x 6.4 y 31.7 w 74.9 h 54.7): line chart with time on the x axis labelled Time (months), ticks 0, 12, 24, 36, 48, 60, 72, range 0 to about 72 months; y axis labelled OS (%), ticks 0 to 100 in steps of 10. Two step-curve series: Pembro + chemo in green (about #2FA301) and Placebo + chemo in grey (about #8C8C8C). Pembro values at 12, 24, 36, 48, 60 months: 66.9%, 38.4%, 24.5%, 18.6%, 12.5%. Placebo values at the same times: 48.5%, 26.1%, 12.2%, 9.9%, 9.3%. Each value is marked by a hollow circle marker on the curve with a thin dotted vertical drop line down to the x axis at 12, 24, 36, 48 and 60 months, and a small dot above each marker. Short vertical tick marks show censored patients along both curves, most dense after 48 months. Below the plot is a No. at risk table with rows Pembro + chemo (green) 255, 169, 97, 62, 47, 18, 0 and Placebo + chemo (grey) 187, 89, 47, 21, 17, 6, 0 under 0, 12, 24, 36, 48, 60, 72. Table (native, upper right, about x 50 to 95 and y 37 to 53): columns Treatment arm, Events, n (%), Median, months (95% CI), HR (95% CI). Row 1 Pembro + chemo: 218 (85.5), 18.3 (15.2–20.9), 0.64 (0.51–0.79), text in green. Row 2 Placebo + chemo: 167 (89.3), 11.4 (9.4–13.2), –, text in grey. A dark grey horizontal rule separates the header from the rows. Logo: KEYTRUDA wordmark in green with a dark navy Y-shaped letter, and (pembrolizumab) beneath in green. Icons: circle 1 light green with a white antibody Y icon; circle 2 'DATA DIVE' text; circle 3 'DOSING' text.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF with a light grey header band #F2F3F3 across the top. White background #FFFFFF with a light grey header band #F2F3F3 across the top 13% of the slide. Title in bold sans-serif (Arial Bold) green #48A548, about 4.4% of slide height, two lines. Subtitle in regular Arial green #48A548 about 3.3% of slide height. Navigation tabs are flat grey rectangles #E3E3E3 with uppercase Arial text #585858 about 1.4% of slide height, no visible corner radius. Circular icons #6DBE45 and #4CA540 with white text. Chart uses thin lines, green #2FA301 and grey #8C8C8C. Table header bold Arial #585858 about 2.2%, rows regular Arial. Footnote text bold/regular Arial #585858 about 1.5%. A thin light grey-blue rule (about #B0B5BA, 1 pt) runs above the footnotes. No shadows or gradients.

**Layout**

A full-width header band across the top 13.3% holds the KEYTRUDA logo at left, six square-cornered navigation buttons in the centre-right and three circular icons at the far right. Below it the title and subtitle are left-aligned at about a 5% left margin, with the Kaplan-Meier chart occupying the centre-left, the comparison table in the upper right, the numbers-at-risk grid beneath the x-axis, and a right-aligned italic citation above a thin rule at the bottom, with footnotes and page number 75 at the foot of the slide.

**Visuals**

Chart: Kaplan-Meier progression-free survival curves. Title: none printed above the plot. X axis labelled 'Time (months)', range 0 to 72, ticks every 12 months. Y axis labelled 'PFS (%)', range 0 to 100, ticks every 10. Series 1 'Pembro + chemo' is a green step line (about #2FA301); series 2 'Placebo + chemo' is a grey step line (about #8C8C8C). Printed labelled values at 12 months: Pembro 30.1%, Placebo 17.9%; at 24 months: Pembro 15.4%, Placebo 9.2%; at 36 months: Pembro 9.5%, Placebo 5.0%; at 48 months: Pembro 7.9%, Placebo 3.7%; at 60 months: Pembro 4.6%, Placebo 3.7%. Highlighted points: open circle markers at each labelled time point on both curves, with dotted vertical drop lines at 12, 24, 36, 48 and 60 months topped by small grey dots; censoring tick marks along both curves. No legend inside the plot; series are identified by the green and grey colour-matched labels in the number-at-risk grid and the table. Table: four columns (Treatment arm; Events, n (%); Median, months (95% CI); HR (95% CI)) and two rows: Pembro + chemo | 238 (93.3) | 6.5 (6.2–8.4) | 0.66 (0.54–0.81); Placebo + chemo | 178 (95.2) | 5.5 (4.7–6.2) | –. Numbers-at-risk grid: rows Pembro + chemo 255, 76, 39, 24, 19, 6, 0 and Placebo + chemo 187, 33, 16, 8, 6, 1, 0 at 0, 12, 24, 36, 48, 60, 72 months. Logo: KEYTRUDA (pembrolizumab) wordmark, green with a dark navy Y-shaped stroke. Icons: three green circles, the first containing a white stylised antibody Y icon, the second and third carrying the text DATA DIVE and DOSING.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF, with a light grey #F2F3F3 header band across the top 13.3%. White slide with a light grey header band #F2F3F3. Title in brand green #48A548, Arial Bold, about 4.4% of slide height, sentence case with hyphens and dashes. Subtitle in green #48A548, Arial regular, about 3.3%. Table header text and chart labels in dark grey #585858, Arial Bold for headers, about 2.2%. Table values for Pembro row in green #2FA301, Placebo row in dark grey #585858. Navigation buttons in #E3E3E3 with dark grey #585858 Arial caps about 1.4%. Circular icons in green #5DB848, #4CA843 and #48A548 with white text about 1.3%. Footer text dark grey #585858, Arial, footnotes about 1.5%, citation Arial Italic about 1.7%. Table header rule dark grey #585858, about 0.3% thick. Footer rule thin light blue-grey #B0B8C4. No shadows, gradients or corner radii on the text elements; navigation buttons have square corners.

**Layout**

Single-column slide on a white field: a light grey header band holds the KEYTRUDA logo at top left, six grey rectangular navigation buttons in the centre-right, and three circular green icons at the far right. The green title sits left-aligned at about 5% margin under the header and wraps to two lines, with a green subtitle beneath it. A full-width line chart with an embedded results table occupies the middle, a No. at risk table sits below the x-axis, and a grey rule above the footer carries the footnotes at the bottom left; the page number 76 sits at bottom left and the italic source line sits at bottom right.

**Visuals**

Line chart (Kaplan-Meier style), titled by slide headline PFS2 for PD-L1 non-expresser patients. Y-axis labelled PFS2 (%), range 0 to 100 with ticks every 10. X-axis labelled Time (months), range 0 to 72 with ticks every 12. Two step-curve series: Pembro + chemo in green (about #3DA535) and Placebo + chemo in grey (about #8C8C8C). Censoring tick marks appear along both curves. Dotted reference lines at 50% PFS2 (horizontal) and at 12, 24, 36, 60 months (vertical). Labelled values at 12 months: 58.2% green and 33.6% grey; at 24 months: 28.6% green and 14.0% grey; at 36 months: 20.1% green and 7.3% grey; at 48 months: 14.8% green and 6.7% grey; at 60 months: 10.3% green and 6.2% grey. No legend; series are identified by the colour-coded row labels in the table and at-risk block. Embedded table with columns Events, n (%), Median, months (95% CI), HR (95% CI) and rows Pembro + chemo (green) 223 (87.5), 14.4 (12.9–15.9), 0.55 and Placebo + chemo (grey) 172 (92.0), 9.2 (7.6–10.2), (0.44–0.68). Below the chart a No. at risk table with columns at 0, 12, 24, 36, 48, 60, 72 months: Pembro + chemo 255, 147, 71, 50, 36, 14, 0; Placebo + chemo 187, 60, 25, 13, 12, 5, 0. Green KEYTRUDA logo mark with a dark navy Y; three circular green icons with white text or Y mark.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background #FFFFFF with a light grey header band #F2F3F3. Title and subtitle in green #48A548; body and axis text in dark grey #2C2C2C and #585858; navigation buttons fill #E3E3E3 with grey #585858 text; circular icons in green #6DBE45 and #48A548. Typeface is Arial (Helvetica-like sans-serif); title Arial Bold at about 4.4% of slide height, subtitle Arial regular at about 3.3%, body and footnotes about 1.5%, navigation labels about 1.4%. Lines are thin dark grey #2C2C2C dotted reference lines and a light grey rule #B0B8C0 above the footer. Shapes have square-ish corners with slight rounding on navigation buttons; no shadows or gradients.

**Layout**

Full-width header band across the top with the KEYTRUDA logo at top left, six grey navigation tabs and three round icon buttons at top right. Title is left-aligned at about 5% from the left edge beneath the band, followed by a green subtitle line; a centred-right two-column table (blank label column, green Pembro + chemo column, grey Placebo + chemo column) sits below with a source line right-aligned above a thin rule, and a footnote block with page number 77 at the bottom left.

**Visuals**

Table with three columns and rows as follows. Header row: blank label cell; 'Pembro + chemo (n=255)' on green #2FA301; 'Placebo + chemo (n=187)' on grey #808285. Row 1: 'ORR (95% CI), %' | 50.6 (44.3–56.9) | 33.2 (26.5–40.4). Row 2 (section label spanning): 'Best overall response, n (%)'. Row 3: Complete response | 4 (1.6) | 5 (2.7). Row 4: Partial response | 125 (49.0) | 57 (30.5). Row 5: Stable disease (superscript b) | 88 (34.5) | 79 (42.2). Row 6: Progressive disease | 20 (7.8) | 31 (16.6). Row 7: Not evaluable (superscript c) | 11 (4.3) | 6 (3.2). Row 8: No assessment (superscript d) | 7 (2.7) | 9 (4.8). Row 9: Median DOR (range), mo | 7.6 (1.1+ to 59.4+) | 5.5 (1.4+ to 55.8+). Data rows alternate light grey #F2F2F2 and white with thin green #6DBE45 separators. No chart, photograph or illustration. Logos: KEYTRUDA (pembrolizumab) wordmark top left; a green Y-shaped icon in a green circle, a 'DATA DIVE' circle and a 'DOSING' circle at top right.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF with a light grey #F2F3F3 header band across the top 13.3%. White content area on a light grey #F2F3F3 header band occupying the top 13.3%. Title in bold sans-serif (Arial Bold) green #48A548, about 4.4% of slide height per line. Subtitle in regular Arial green #48A548, about 3.3%. Navigation labels in regular Arial uppercase #585858, about 1.4%. Table body text in regular Arial #585858 about 2.2%. Footnotes in Arial Bold #585858 about 1.5%, source line in Arial Italic #585858 about 1.7%. Accent green #2FA301 for the Pembro column header and #6DBE45 for row rules; grey #808285 for Placebo header. Line and shape styles: flat rectangles with no rounded corners for table cells and navigation tabs; navigation tabs are light grey #E3E3E3 boxes; icons are solid circles. Thin light-blue-grey rule above the footnotes. No shadows or gradients.

The exploratory pooled analysis included patient data from KEYNOTE-189 global (data cut-off March 8, 2022) and Japan extension (data cut-off February 7, 2023) and the KEYNOTE-407 global (data cut-off February 23, 2022) and China extension (data cut-off February 10, 2023).

**Layout**

Full-width header band across the top with the KEYNOTE logo at upper left and six grey navigation buttons plus three round green icons at upper right. Left-aligned green title in two lines below the band, with a green subtitle line beneath it. Below the subtitle, a boxed horizontal bar chart sits at left (about 5% to 44% of width) and a green-headed table sits at right (about 60% to 96% of width), with the chart legend between them. Attribution line is right-aligned above a thin footer rule; footnotes are left-aligned in the bottom band with the slide number at far left at the margin.

**Visuals**

Chart: horizontal floating bar chart (Kaplan-style patient timeline) inside a thin dark-grey (#555555) 1 px bordered box. Title: none printed. X-axis: 'Time, mo', linear, 0 to 60, major ticks and labels every 6 months (0, 6, 12, 18, 24, 30, 36, 42, 48, 54, 60). Y-axis: no labels; 27 horizontal patient rows, one per patient (n=27), top to bottom.
