**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF, with a light grey #F2F3F3 band across the top 13.3% of the slide. White content area on a very light grey header band (#F2F3F3). Titles and subtitle in green #48A548 Arial-style sans-serif (Arial Bold for title, Arial Regular for subtitle). Body and table text grey #585858 in Arial Regular; table header text white Arial Bold. Title about 4.4% of slide height per line (cap height about 3.1%); subtitle about 3.3%; chart labels and table text about 2.2%; footnotes about 1.5%. Accents: green #2FA301 for treatment bars and table header, light green #A7D992 for follow-up bars, table row fills #F2F2F2 with green #48A548 horizontal rules between rows. Navigation buttons: flat grey #E3E3E3 rectangles, square corners, no shadow, grey #585858 text. Round icons are flat fills, no shadow. Chart frame: thin #555555 square-cornered border. Footer rule: thin light blue-grey line. No gradients or shadows.

**Layout**

Full-width header band across the top 13% of the slide with the KEYTRUDA logo at the left and six grey navigation buttons plus three round green icon buttons across the right. Title block is left-aligned at about 5% from the left edge, with the subtitle beneath it. Below, two bar charts sit side by side: the placebo chart in the left half with its category labels in a centred column between the charts, and the pembrolizumab chart at right. A footnote block with a page number at the bottom left sits under a thin rule near the bottom edge.

**Visuals**

Chart 1: butterfly bar chart, horizontal stacked bars, 'Placebo + chemo (n=186)', left half. Series: Grade 1-2 solid grey #808285 bars and Grade 3-5 hatched grey bars. Value axis 70 to 0 reversed, ticks every 10, grey #929292 tick labels. Left-end labels are Grade 3-5 values; right-end labels are Grade 1-2 values. Rows top to bottom with Grade 3-5 / Grade 1-2 values: Anaemia 21.0 / 37.6; Nausea 2.7 / 39.8; Appetite 0.0 / 31.7; Fatigue 3.2 / 22.0; Diarrhoea 2.7 / 21.5; Constipation 1.6 / 30.1; Neutropenia 20.4 / 7.5; Alopecia 0.5 / 30.6; Thrombocytopenia 8.1 / 15.6; Asthenia 4.8 / 16.1; Vomiting 2.2 / 14.5; Cough 0.0 / 23.1; Arthralgia 0.5 / 17.7; Rash 1.1 / 10.2; Pyrexia 2.2 / 16.7; White blood cell count 8.6 / 10.2; Neutrophil count 12.9 / 3.2; Dyspnoea 1.1 / 18.3. No highlighted points. Chart 2: butterfly bar chart, 'Pembro + chemo (n=254)', right half. Series: Grade 1-2 solid green #2FA301 and Grade 3-5 hatched green. Value axis 0 to 70, ticks every 10. Labels: left-end values are Grade 1-2, right-end values Grade 3-5. Rows: Anaemia 39.4 / 15.4; Nausea 45.7 / 2.0; Appetite 33.1 / 0.8; Fatigue 26.8 / 5.9; Diarrhoea 29.1 / 3.5; Constipation 28.7 / 0.4; Neutropenia 13.0 / 15.4; Alopecia 25.6 / 0.4; Thrombocytopenia 16.5 / 8.3; Asthenia 17.7 / 4.3; Vomiting 19.3 / 2.4; Cough 19.7 / 0.4; Arthralgia 19.7 / 0.8; Rash 18.5 / 0.4; Pyrexia 18.5 / 0.0; White blood cell count 10.6 / 6.3; Neutrophil count 3.9 / 10.2; Dyspnoea 11.8 / 0.8. Legend above each chart: grey square Grade 1-2 and hatched square Grade 3-5 (left, grey); green square Grade 1-2 and hatched square Grade 3-5 (right, green). No logos other than the KEYTRUDA wordmark and three round icons in the header.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF, with a light grey #F2F3F3 header band across the top 13.3%. Clean white slide with a light grey #F2F3F3 header band. Title in Arial Bold green #48A548, about 4.4% of slide height per line, with the subtitle in Arial Regular green #48A548 at about 3.3%. Chart body and category labels in Arial Regular grey #585858 at about 1.7%. Placebo elements grey #808285 and pembrolizumab elements green #2FA301. Navigation buttons are flat rectangles fill #E3E3E3 with no visible shadow, text Arial Regular #585858 at about 1.4% in capitals. Icon circles are solid green with white text at about 1.3%. Footnote text Arial Bold #585858 at about 1.5%. Thin grey horizontal rule above the footer. No gradients or shadows.

**Layout**

Full-width white slide with a light grey header band across the top 13 percent holding the KEYTRUDA logo at left, six grey rounded nav tabs and three green circular icon buttons at right. The green bold title sits left-aligned at about 5 percent margin below the header, with a green subtitle beneath it; below that a two-sided butterfly bar chart spans the middle with the category labels centred between the two halves. A thin grey rule runs above a footer with the page number 81 at left and footnotes in the bottom 10 percent; the source credit is right-aligned above the rule.

**Visuals**

Butterfly bar chart (horizontal bars) with two panels sharing a centred category axis. Left panel: Placebo + chemo (n=186), grey #808285 bars, value axis reversed from 10 at far left through 5 to 0 at the centre, no unit printed. Right panel: Pembro + chemo (n=254), green #2FA301 bars, value axis 0 at centre through 5 to 10 at far right, no unit printed. Each bar has a solid segment (Grade 1-2) and a hatched segment (Grade 3-5, diagonal stripes). Legend above each panel: solid square = Grade 1-2, hatched square = Grade 3-5. Labelled values, placebo (left of bar, then right of bar) and pembro (left of bar, then right of bar): Hypothyroidism placebo 0.0 / 2.2, pembro 8.3 solid and 0.4 hatched; Hyperthyroidism 0.0 / 2.2, pembro 6.3 and 0.0; Pneumonitis placebo 1.1 hatched / 1.6, pembro 2.4 solid and 3.9 hatched; Infusion reactions placebo 0.0 / 1.6, pembro 3.5 solid and 1.2 hatched; Colitis placebo 0.5 hatched / 0.0, pembro 0.8 solid and 1.2 hatched; Hepatitis placebo 0.0, pembro 0.4 solid and 1.6 hatched; Nephritis placebo 0.5 hatched / 0.0, pembro 0.4 solid and 1.6 hatched; Severe skin reactions placebo 1.6 hatched / 0.0, pembro 0.8 solid and 0.8 hatched; Hypophysitis placebo 0.0, pembro 0.8 solid and 0.4 hatched; Adrenal insufficiency placebo 0.0, pembro 0.8 solid and 0.0; Pancreatitis placebo 0.0, pembro 0.0 hatched and 0.8 hatched; Thyroiditis placebo 0.0, pembro 0.8 solid and 0.0; Encephalitis placebo 0.0, pembro 0.0 hatched and 0.4 hatched; Guillain-Barré syndrome placebo 0.0, pembro 0.0 hatched and 0.4 hatched; Myositis placebo 0.0, pembro 0.4 solid and 0.0; Type 1 diabetes mellitus placebo 0.0, pembro 0.0 hatched and 0.4 hatched; Vasculitis placebo 0.0, pembro 0.4 solid and 0.0. No highlighted points. Thin grey horizontal baseline under each panel. Small italic grey source credit at bottom right. Logo: KEYTRUDA wordmark in green with a dark navy Y-shaped stylised letter, registered mark, and (pembrolizumab) beneath. Icons: three green circles at top right, the first with a white Y-shaped glyph, the second labelled DATA DIVE, the third labelled DOSING. No photographs.

**Design**

Background white #FFFFFF with a light grey #F2F3F3 header band. Title text green #48A548, bold Arial-style sans-serif at about 4.4 percent of slide height, title case, left aligned. Nav tab labels dark grey #585858 regular Arial capitals at about 1.4 percent on #E3E3E3 tabs with square-ish rounded corners and no shadow. Chart axis numbers grey #929292. ### Slide 82

**Text**

KEYTRUDA® (pembrolizumab)
ESMO RECOMMENDATIONS
STUDY OVERVIEW
CLINICAL OUTCOMES
SUMMARY OF OUTCOMES
POOLED ANALYSIS
PD-L1 EXPRESSION
DATA DIVE
DOSING
KEYNOTE-189 & KEYNOTE-407: Post-hoc exploratory pooled analysis –
summary of efficacy and safety data at 5-year follow-up1
●
The 5-year pooled analysis data shows pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy demonstrated numerical improvements in OS, PFS and ORR compared with chemotherapy alone in this exploratory analysis of with patients with previously untreated mNSCLC PD-L1 TPS <1% without EGFR/ALK alterations enrolled in KEYNOTE-189 and KEYNOTE-407
●
Pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy had a manageable toxicity profile
●
Patients in this subgroup who completed 35 cycles (~2 years) of pembrolizumab experienced durable responses and 57% were alive 3 years after completion of 35 cycles (~5 years after randomisation)
●
These results continue to support pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy as a standard-of-care first-line therapy for mNSCLC patients with PD-L1 TPS <1%
82
1. Gadgeel S et al. J Thor Oncol. 2024. DOI:https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jtho.2024.04.011.

### Slide 84

**Text**

PD-L1 expression in mNSCLC patients
Immunohistochemical evaluation of PD-L1
Is based on TPS, which is the % of viable tumour cells showing partial or complete membrane staining at any intensity.1
PD-L1 expression levels can affect approaches to treating patients:2,3
● Single-agent immunotherapy
● Combination immunotherapy
The prevalence of PD-L1 expression in patients with NSCLC ranges from 24%–60%4
Of patients with mNSCLC, ~30% have tumours with PD-L1 expression <1%*5,6
ESMO RECOMMENDATIONS
STUDY OVERVIEW
CLINICAL OUTCOMES
SUMMARY OF OUTCOMES
POOLED ANALYSIS
PD-L1 EXPRESSION
DATA DIVE
DOSING
KEYTRUDA (pembrolizumab)
84
*TPS <1%.
1. Sajjadi E et al. Ecancermedicalscience 2020;14:1150; 2. Ettinger DS et al. J Natl Compr Canc Netw 2021;19:254-266; 3. Vrankar M et al. Radiat Oncol 2020;15:247; 4. Yu H et al. J Thorac Oncol 2016;11:964-975; 5. Aggarwal C et al. Ann Oncol 2016;27:1060P; 6. Holmes M et al. J Thorac Oncol 2019;14:S506.

**Layout**

**Visuals**

Three green chevron arrows in a row, left to right: 'Some NSCLCs are cold tumours that lack activated tumour-specific T cells', 'Absence of tumour-specific T cells is a mechanism of primary resistance to ICBs', 'Effective combination therapy can turn cold tumours into hot tumours that are sensitive to ICBs'. Above the third chevron a grey italic note reads 'This is a hypothesis based on experimental models'. Left illustration: a cluster of tan/orange tumour cells with blue nuclei on a blue glow, with one green CD8+ T cell at upper left and one green cell at lower right and a lavender NK cell at bottom centre; six green curved arrows point from the cluster to the labels 'Lack of CD8 cytotoxic T cells', 'Lack of PD-L1 expression', 'Lack of immunoregulatory genes', 'Poor antigen presentation', 'Increased MDSCs', 'Increased Tregs'. Right illustration: a cluster of tan tumour cells with blue nuclei on a red/pink glow, containing green CD8+ T cells and lavender NK cells; four green curved arrows point to 'Prominent CD8 cytotoxic T cell infiltration', 'PD-L1 expression', 'Suppression of immunosuppressive cells', 'Increased pro-inflammatory cytokines'. Bottom-left legend with small icons: tan circle 'Tumor cell', green circle 'CD8+ T Cell', lavender circle 'NK cell'. Logo at top left: green KEYTRUDA wordmark with a stylised Y and '(pembrolizumab)' beneath. Top-right: a green circular icon of a stylised Y/antibody shape, and two green circles labelled DATA DIVE and DOSING.

Please note that clicking these links will redirect you to external websites, for which MSD does not review or control the content.

**Layout**

A full-width green header band across the top holds the KEYTRUDA logo at the left, a row of five grey rounded nav buttons, and three green circular icons at the right. Below it, centred on a light grey rounded panel, a KEYNOTE-189 bar sits over seven white-on-green columns of differing heights, and a navy bar closes the panel. A thin grey rule runs above the footer, with the page number 88 at the left margin, the source text beside it and two grey circular arrow buttons at the bottom right.

**Visuals**

Diagram: a hierarchy of nested rectangles with no arrows. At the top, one wide green bar labelled KEYNOTE-189 spans the panel. Beneath it are seven columns of green rectangles, each with a white heading and light green (#6CC04A-tinted, white at 30 percent opacity over green) sub-boxes stacked vertically: column OS contains ITT, PDL-1 TPS, Key subgroups; column PFS contains ITT, PDL-1 TPS, PFS2, Key subgroups; column ORR/DOR contains ORR (ITT + PDL-1 TPS), DOR/DCR (ITT [original analysis]), DOR (ITT + PD-L1 TPS [5 year]); column Safety contains AEs, All cause AEs, Immune mediated AEs, Renal AEs; column Liver Mets contains OS and PFS; column Brain Mets contains OS and PFS; column HRQoL contains QLQ-C30, QLQ-LC13, Time to deterioration. Columns have different heights and do not align at the bottom. A navy bar labelled KEYNOTE-189 & KEYNOTE-407 pooled analysis sits at the bottom of the panel. Logo: KEYTRUDA wordmark in green with a navy Y-shaped antibody glyph, with (pembrolizumab) beneath in grey. Icons: a white antibody glyph in a green circle, a DATA DIVE text circle and a DOSING text circle. Two grey circular arrow buttons with white chevrons (left and right) at bottom right.

**Design**

Background white #FFFFFF with a very light grey header band #F2F3F3 across the top 13 percent. Grey panel #E3E3E3 at 50 percent opacity with rounded corners of about 1 percent of slide width. Titles and column headings white #FFFFFF in Arial regular, about 3.2 percent of slide height. Body and sub-box text white #FFFFFF in Arial regular, about 2.2 percent. Column fills #2FA301 with sub-boxes white at 30 percent opacity, rounded corners small. Navy accent bar #2A3166. Nav button text grey #585858 in Arial regular, about 1.4 percent, on light grey buttons. Footer text grey #585858 in Arial regular about 1.5 percent; URL green #6CC04A; warning line bold Arial in grey #585858. Footer hairline in light grey-blue. Page number Arial regular grey #585858 about 1.7 percent.

### Slide 89

**Text**

KEYTRUDA (pembrolizumab)
ESMO RECOMMENDATIONS / STUDY OVERVIEW / CLINICAL OUTCOMES / SUMMARY OF OUTCOMES / POOLED ANALYSIS / PD-L1 EXPRESSION / DATA DIVE / DOSING
KEYTRUDA offers flexibility of dosing
Administered as an IV infusion
Over 30 minutes
200 mg Q3W or 400 mg Q6W
● The 200 mg Q3W (once every 3 weeks) regimen has been assessed in phase 2 and 3 registration studies across a multitude of indications of KEYTRUDA. An exposure-response evaluation, using modelling and simulation, led to the approval of the 400 mg Q6W (once every 6 weeks) dosing for monotherapy and combination therapy.
89
KEYTRUDA (pembrolizumab) Summary of Product Characteristics. Available from: https://www.medicines.org.uk/emc/product/2498/smpc

**Layout**

Full-width white slide with a light grey header band across the top 13% holding the KEYTRUDA (pembrolizumab) logo at left, a row of six grey rounded navigation tabs and three green circular buttons at right. The title sits left-aligned under the header at about 16% from top with a 5% left margin. Three equal rounded cards sit in a row at the middle, followed by one bullet paragraph, a thin rule and a footer with page number at bottom left.

**Visuals**

Three rounded light blue-grey cards (#CADCDE at 60% opacity) in a row, each with a flat line icon at left and bold centred label at right. Card 1: IV drip bag icon with dark navy outline (#1B1B33) and green (#6CC04A) fluid level, hanging from a hook. Card 2: stopwatch icon with dark outline, dotted outer circle and green filled right half of dial with tick marks. Card 3: calendar icon with dark outline, green-outlined date squares and a black circle with check mark overlapping the bottom right corner. Navigation tabs and circles contain no imagery; the top-left KEYTRUDA logo is a green wordmark with a navy Y-shaped ribbon over the E, with a registered mark and the word (pembrolizumab) beneath. The top-right first green circle holds a white Y-shaped antibody icon; the second green circle contains the text DATA DIVE and the third contains DOSING. No photographs, charts or tables.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF with a light grey #F2F3F3 header band across the top 13.3%.
